fxPricing.heading: FX pricing
fxPricing.description: Derives USD and EUR variant prices from the native PLN selling price, using the NBP (Polish central bank) table A mid rate plus a configurable margin. Runs daily; manual price edits are never overwritten - see the README for how that is guaranteed.

enabled.heading: Enabled
enabled.description: Off by default. While off, the daily job and the manual recompute below both no-op.
enabled.forcedOffBadge: Forced off by FX_PRICING_DISABLED in the environment

configuration.heading: Configuration
configuration.noMarginWarning: No margin multiplier is set, so recompute runs refuse and no price is written. This plugin ships without a default margin on purpose - it will not guess a markup for your store. Set one below to start pricing.
configuration.marginHelp: foreign_amount = pln_amount / nbp_rate * margin_multiplier. Use 1 for no markup, 1.25 for 25% on top of the raw NBP mid rate. Required: while this is blank, runs refuse rather than guess a markup.
configuration.stalenessHelp: If the latest published NBP rate is older than this, that currency is skipped for the run instead of pricing off a stale rate.

summary.currencyDisabled: {{code}}: skipped - not enabled in the store's supported currencies
summary.rateUnavailable: {{code}}: skipped - the NBP rate could not be fetched
summary.rateStale: {{code}}: skipped - the latest NBP rate ({{date}}) is older than the staleness tolerance
summary.line: {{code}}: rate {{rate}} ({{date}}) - created {{created}}, updated {{updated}}, unchanged {{unchanged}}, manual overrides skipped {{skippedManualOverride}}, no PLN price {{skippedNoPlnPrice}}

toasts.saved: Saved. The next run - scheduled or manual - uses this. No restart needed.
toasts.cleared: Cleared. Both settings fall back to whatever this plugin was installed with.
toasts.recomputeSkipped: Nothing ran - FX pricing is disabled.
toasts.recomputeSuccess: Recompute finished. See the summary below.

errors.marginInvalid: Enter a margin multiplier greater than 0, e.g. 1.10 for a 10% margin.
errors.stalenessInvalid: Enter a staleness tolerance in whole hours, greater than 0.
